definition: The plate is drawn from the pack's own figures: each band a member at its stated height and projection, its profile constructed by rule, never traced. An unpublished projection is drawn dashed at the naked, an unconstructable profile as its dashed box, both said.
basis: Our wording of how a plate's profiles are made, from the moulding-geometry module and the grammar layer. build/profiles.py: "every shape below is drawn from the member's own two numbers by a rule named in its docstring."; build/profiles.py: "Nothing here traces a photograph or fits a curve to one"; build/profiles.py: "ENVELOPE -- the box their published height and projection"; docs/proportion.md: "from the member's own height and projection, never a curve fitted to look right"; docs/proportion.md: "these draw as their envelope, the dashed box their"; docs/proportion.md: "what can no longer happen is a picture wrong on its own". Re-read at the merge of the two Phase 14s (27 Sep 2026): the ink line drew an unconstructed member as its envelope and an unpublished face as a ghost at its naked, where this record had said "drawn plain" and quoted two sentences that line had since rewritten.
